checks.name: manuscript-mask-logit-notation
checks.detail: Eq. (2) adds log m_{g,j} to the attention logits, so an unavailable token takes a logit of -inf. Algorithm 1 line 10 writes the same term as 'log M', a positive constant that would shift every logit equally and mask nothing.

checks.name: manuscript-mask-index-space
checks.detail: Sec. 2.1 defines the availability mask over the L tokens the encoder builds and writes m_{g,j} with j indexing that token axis; Algorithm 1 loops j over the M evidence layers and tests m_{g,j}. The two statements index the same symbol over different spaces.

checks.name: manuscript-context-token-duplication
checks.detail: Sec. 2.3 states that the keystone layer is realised as the graph-context embedding, so it is one of the M = 4 layer tokens; Algorithm 1 builds a token per layer and then appends u_ctx(h_g) again, which yields five tokens for four layers.

checks.name: manuscript-table6-column-reference

checks.name: manuscript-figure1-baseline-caption
